text_block_list.text:
One day, after winning numerous races with 
Admire Vega.

After finishing our daily training with 
her, I returned to the Trainer's Office 
and resumed my work, when――

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Excuse me.
choice_data_list:
Oh, Ayabe! I thought you'd already headed 
home...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...There's something I need to talk to you 
about.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"About the thing you were holding onto for 
me... Do you remember?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Here. ...Will you hold onto this for 
me?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, I still don't really know. 
...What it is that I want to do.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Whether they want to go... or not.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's just... I wouldn't say I have no 
interest in a special starry sky, so...

In a flash, the memories of back then came 
rushing back. The onsen voucher I had kept 
safe until Admire Vega could learn to face 
herself—

The fact that this topic is coming from 
her mouth right now means...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —I want to go.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I heard the starry sky is beautiful there. 
I... want to go see it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Would you come with me?
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list:
Did you enjoy the starry sky from the 
open-air bath?

Did you enjoy the starry sky in the 
open-air bath?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, very much so.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Still, since we're here, just a little 
more—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...I think I'll go for a short walk 
outside.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Following me? ...You too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Well, you followed me here, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You stayed by my side, didn't you? ...All 
this time, right from the start.

The late-night air was bitingly cold. The 
breath escaping my heated body formed a 
glowing white mist that drifted away and 
vanished.

It looked almost like a nebula. Breathing 
out a tiny universe with a soft sigh, 
Admire Vega murmured quietly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's gorgeous, truly.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...It all started because I felt it would 
connect me to my sister.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"I started looking up at the stars because 
I wanted to talk to my little sister. 
...Whenever I had free time back home, I'd 
go out onto the balcony, wrap myself in a 
cape, and gaze up at the night sky."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, because of that, I started 
getting interested in the stars themselves 
too."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Reading books, researching, listening to 
talks at the planetarium..."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
And so, I shared all that newly gained 
knowledge with my sister again.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
About the tales discovered in the 
constellations. About the wondrous 
mysteries of the boundless universe.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
For me— they are precious memories that 
were so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
So... yeah. I like looking up at the 
stars.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Because whenever I look up, I always think 
of her.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"We may not be able to talk anymore... 
Even so, the fact that the stars are the 
guideposts connecting her and me will 
never change."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's why I love the stars.

"In a gentle voice that seemed to softly 
cradle those precious feelings, Admire 
Vega murmured."

"After that, she fell silent, and we 
walked beneath the starry sky for a 
while."

"Would it be alright if I spoke a little 
too?" Thinking that, suddenly—
I tried pausing for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...? ...What is it?
choice_data_list:
Do you have a favorite constellation or 
something?

Do you have a favorite constellation or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Gemini holds a lot of sentimental value 
for me. ...And the rest—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The Southern Cross. ...Do you know of it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
The smallest among the eighty-eight 
constellations in the entire sky. Yet, it 
was the star that guided travelers heading 
south.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...You can't see it from here. To begin 
with, it's a star that's hard to see from 
the Northern Hemisphere.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: So... yeah.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —I want to go see it for myself someday.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's what I'm thinking.

With a calm expression, she gazes up at 
the sky.

I couldn't help but pray that their wish 
would come true one day...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(...Even if that 'someday' were to 
come...)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Will you follow me there too?)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (—I'll ask someday.)

It was a moment where I felt an 
irreplaceable bond with Admire Vega...
